title: hashicorp/go-retryablehttp
notes: retryablehttp.NewClient() over its default pooled transport (cleanhttp, GOMAXPROCS+1 idle connections per host). RetryMax is 0, since the task has no retries, and Logger is nil, since the default writes a line to standard error for every request. The body is read and decoded by encoding/json into an untyped value. The body is the fixture's prepared text, passed as bytes to client.Post with Content-Type application/json.
